'''ChaseMasters''' were [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] produced by [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and used as [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] around [[43 ABY]]. The ''[[Black Wave]]'' was one such ChaseMaster; it was commanded, along with ten other ChaseMaster frigates, by [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]].
